categories.SHELL: Site chrome rendered by the shared Layout around every route: announcement banner, fixed header, footer.
categories.HERO: The page-opening block that states what the route is about.
categories.PROOF: Social proof: customer logo tickers, testimonials, stat cards.
categories.FEATURES: Product explanation modules that are NOT scroll-pinned.
categories.NARRATIVE: Scroll-pinned or scroll-scrubbed storytelling sections (GSAP ScrollTrigger pins).
categories.CONVERSION: Calls to action, FAQs and forms that move a visitor to sign up or contact.
categories.CONTENT: Long-form body content: prose, legal text, company story, confirmations.
categories.DIRECTORY: Index and navigation lists over a collection: post lists, resource link lists, related links, pagination.
categories.LEGACY: Blocks from the older px-based partner page kit (its own palette and slider), used only by partner template A and its cut-down variant.

shell.announcement-banner.description: Full-width dark-green strip above the header with one linked announcement sentence; scrolls away; sets --banner-height.

shell.header.description: Fixed pill header: wordmark, primary nav, click-open Platform flyout, burger-driven mobile/tablet menu.

shell.footer.description: Dark-green footer: wordmark, two link columns, legal links, social icons, desktop edge line art.

hero.home-tabs.description: Homepage hero: headline + side description over three auto-advancing illustrated tabs with timer rings and a popup CTA after the last tab.

hero.page-platform.description: PageHero platform variant: eyebrow, black h1, description, large absolutely positioned product visual with corner line art; staggered reveal.

hero.page-landing.description: PageHero landing variant: eyebrow, h1 with green span, description, in-flow 1080u visual that scales in.
hero.page-landing.scope: Payroll, tax and handbooks product pages plus the for-hr and for-telehealth solution pages (5 routes).

hero.static.description: HeroStatic: centered eyebrow/h1/description over a looping line-art illustration with edge line art; optional red button row; no text reveal.
hero.static.scope: Entity product, solutions overview (+smb), reinstatement, and every static and platform partner page (12 routes).

hero.about.description: About hero: eyebrow and title rising in, wide team illustration scaling from .95.

hero.guide.description: Gated-guide hero: eyebrow, title, description, CTA button and a book-cover image partly overlapped by the next section; staggered reveal.
hero.guide.scope: Every guide landing except the form-only newsletter guide (7 routes).

hero.title-band.description: Plain title band: small eyebrow over an h1/h2 on a light background, no image, no motion.
hero.title-band.scope: Blog index pages and author detail pages (9 routes).

hero.post-header.description: Article header: h1, avatar + author + date byline (date-only on resource guides), featured image.
hero.post-header.scope: Blog posts and resource guide leaves (1766 routes).

proof.logo-ticker-home.description: Homepage 'Trusted by' block: title and two opposite-direction logo rows that run from page load and never stop; 80/260 padding.

proof.benefit-stats.description: Three stat cards (large figure + one-sentence description) with a middle-first reveal.
